# WibuKey64.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

WibuKey for Windows releases before 6.70 are affected by CVE-2024-45181 and CVE-2024-45182. Version 6.70 is separately affected by the boundary-validation flaw documented in WIBU-100057 and fixed in 6.71. The tracked 6.40 and 6.50a builds fall in the first affected range. In the tracked 6.70 build, subcommand 0x14 of IOCTL 0x8200E804 combines a caller-controlled offset with an input-buffer pointer without validating that the resulting object remains inside the request, enabling out-of-bounds kernel access.
- **UUID**: a07e5897-3835-4188-9e3e-bd810c3e34a5
- **Created**: 2026-08-31
- **Author**: Michael Haag
- **Acknowledgement**: fluffycats31 | [@fluffycats31](https://twitter.com/@fluffycats31)

### Commands

```
sc.exe create WibuKey type= kernel binPath= C:\\windows\\temp\\WibuKey64.sys &amp;&amp; sc.exe start WibuKey
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Read and corrupt kernel memory | User | Windows |
